definition.name: bird.retrieve.v2
definition.title: bird.retrieve.v2
definition.description: Bounded read-only Bird retrieval with advisory Jev choices and deterministic execution policy.

steps.name: prepare
steps.title: Validate retrieval request
steps.description: Extract exact candidates and validate bounded input.

steps.name: bounded-retrieval
steps.title: Bounded retrieval attempts
steps.description: At most three executions; terminal verdicts skip remaining actions.

children.name: choose
children.title: Choose read-only action
children.description: Advisory typed judgments; deterministic policy owns execution. Skipped after a terminal verdict.

children.name: execute
children.title: Retrieve selected source
children.description: Validate advisory answers, preserve requested source, execute one read-only action, deduplicate exact records.

children.name: judge-evidence
children.title: Judge safe continuation
children.description: Advisory typed judgments; deterministic policy owns execution. Skipped after a terminal verdict.

children.name: check
children.title: Validate continuation
children.description: Validate semantic Noul only when deterministic evidence supports continuation.
